name: Trail of Bits skills (agentic-actions-auditor)
author: Trail of Bits

amendments.append: Workflows that run an AI agent never place event data in its prompt — no `${{ github.event.* }}` (or an env var carrying it) and no `gh issue view` / `gh pr view` output or CI logs, unless an AGT-4 leg is removed — never `eval` or execute the agent's output, never allow every user to trigger it (`allowed_non_write_users: '*'`), and never grant a tool that accepts shell substitution (`Bash(*)`). *Enforced by:* the kit's workflow semgrep rules + `zizmor`.

notes: CC-BY-SA-4.0: ideas only, no text copied. Repo ships hooks and an MCP server — not installed.
rationale: Source for AGT-6's AI-in-CI vectors: the most systematic list of prompt-injection paths through workflows; Sentry's gha-security-review covers the same ground less completely and is recorded as supporting. CC-BY-SA, so ideas only. Not installed (hooks and an MCP server).
